_body:
Cue: Non-existent absolute directory path
Text: Use the current working directory instead of specifying a non-existent absolute path.

Failed:
```
ls: impossible d'accéder à '/home/user/' : Aucun fichier ou répertoire de ce type
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"ls -la"}
```

Cue: Handling an opaque or specific tool error code
Text: When encountering a non-descriptive error like E42, append diagnostic commands using shell redirection and operators to print stderr and inspect the executable to determine the cause of the failure.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes 2\u003e\u00261; echo \"---\"; cat ./bin/acme 2\u003e/dev/null | head -20 || file ./bin/acme"}
```

Cue: "make test" fails with "workspace not initialised"
Text: Run "make bootstrap" before "make test" to initialize the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":60}
```

Cue: Using an absolute file path that does not exist
Text: Use a relative file path starting from the working directory instead of a hardcoded absolute path.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"lib/strings.sh","new_string":"# string helpers\ntrim_left() { printf '%s' \"$1\" | sed 's/^ *//'; }\nupper() { printf '%s' \"$1\" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'; }\nrepeat() { i=0; while [ $i -lt \"$2\" ]; do printf '%s' \"$1\"; i=$((i+1)); done; }\n# reviewed","old_string":"# string helpers\ntrim_left() { printf '%s' \"$1\" | sed 's/^ *//'; }\nupper() { printf '%s' \"$1\" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'; }\nrepeat() { i=0; while [ $i -lt \"$2\" ]; do printf '%s' \"$1\"; i=$((i+1)); done; }"}
```

Cue: running a migration script without specifying the database backend
Text: include the --db flag with a valid connection string (e.g., --db sqlite:./dev.db) when calling the migration script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```

Cue: acme build requires --profile
Text: Provide the required --profile argument with a value of dev or prod when calling the acme build command.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev","timeout":30}
```

Cue: saving memory with a name containing spaces or colons
Text: ensure the name argument contains only lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens.

Failed:
```
invalid name: use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (for example "no-force-push")
```

Worked:
```
{"content":"When the user asks the agent to reply with \"one short line\", always keep the entire reply to a single short line — no extra text, no explanation, no preamble.","description":"User preference: reply with one short line","name":"reply-format-one-short-line","type":"feedback"}
```

Cue: Calling the Bash tool with a `workingDirectory` argument
Text: Do not include the `workingDirectory` argument in the Bash tool call as it is not a supported parameter.

Failed:
```
validating root: unexpected additional properties ["workingDirectory"]
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"ls -la \u0026\u0026 find . -maxdepth 3 -name README.md -o -name \"README\" 2\u003e/dev/null | head -20"}
```

Cue: Workspace not initialized error when running make
Text: Run make bootstrap before make test to ensure the workspace is initialized.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-test-3-jtyh38d7 \u0026\u0026 make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":30}
```

Cue: migrate.sh script reports no database configured
Text: Include the --db flag with the appropriate database URL when calling the migrate script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-migrate-2-dilke_ms \u0026\u0026 ./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db 2\u003e\u00261"}
```

Cue: File not found due to incorrect absolute path
Text: Use the correct relative path based on the current working directory instead of an incorrect absolute path.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/repos/purple/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/repos/purple/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"lib/strings.sh"}
```
